meta.notes: Gold target plans for Study C. Linked cases use NLI-verified plan component classification over OpenR1-Psy counselor_think; unlinked cases are generated from patient_summary + critical_entities.

c_001.plan: Therapy: CBT-style cognitive restructuring (identify and challenge unhelpful thoughts). Therapy: graded exposure for avoidance triggers. Follow-up: monitor symptoms, medication effects if relevant, and review/practise homework. Case anchors: Problem: major depressive disorder. Constraints/Meds: sertraline 50 mg daily; penicillin allergy.

plan_component_evidence.cbt_cognitive_restructuring: The plan includes CBT-style cognitive restructuring (thought challenging).
plan_component_evidence.exposure: The plan includes exposure-based work for anxiety or avoidance.

c_002.plan: Therapy: trauma-focused CBT or EMDR. Medication: Continue/monitor sertraline 50 mg daily; SSRI (e.g., sertraline) with prazosin for nightmares if indicated. Skills: grounding techniques, safety planning, and emotion regulation. Follow-up: flashback frequency and sleep quality assessment. Case anchors: Problem: post-traumatic stress disorder. Constraints/Meds: sertraline 50 mg daily; codeine allergy.

c_003.plan: Therapy: complicated grief treatment (CGT) or grief-focused CBT. Medication: Continue/monitor sertraline 50 mg daily; antidepressant if major depressive episode co-occurs. Skills: gradual re-engagement with life, memory processing. Follow-up: prolonged grief disorder symptoms and functioning. Case anchors: Problem: complicated grief / prolonged grief. Constraints/Meds: sertraline 50 mg daily; codeine allergy.

c_004.plan: Skills: grounding/breathing to reduce acute distress. Therapy: graded exposure for avoidance triggers. Follow-up: monitor symptoms, medication effects if relevant, and review/practise homework. Case anchors: Problem: panic disorder. Constraints/Meds: sertraline 100 mg daily; codeine allergy.

plan_component_evidence.grounding_distress_tolerance: The plan includes grounding techniques or breathing exercises.
plan_component_evidence.exposure: The plan includes exposure-based work for anxiety or avoidance.

c_005.plan: Therapy: graded exposure for avoidance triggers. Follow-up: monitor symptoms, medication effects if relevant, and review/practise homework. Case anchors: Problem: autism spectrum condition with sensory overload. Constraints/Meds: codeine allergy.

plan_component_evidence.exposure: The plan includes exposure-based work for anxiety or avoidance.

c_006.plan: Therapy: CBT with exposure hierarchy for social situations. Medication: Continue/monitor sertraline 100 mg daily; SSRI (e.g., sertraline) for moderate-severe anxiety. Skills: cognitive restructuring, gradual exposure, and relaxation techniques. Follow-up: avoidance behaviors and functional impairment. Case anchors: Problem: social anxiety disorder. Constraints/Meds: sertraline 100 mg daily; codeine allergy.

c_007.plan: Safety: assess risk and develop a safety plan if indicated. Therapy: CBT-style cognitive restructuring (identify and challenge unhelpful thoughts). Therapy: behavioural activation (schedule small, achievable activities). Therapy: graded exposure for avoidance triggers. Follow-up: monitor symptoms, medication effects if relevant, and review/practise homework. Case anchors: Problem: anger dysregulation in emotionally unstable personality structure. Constraints/Meds: sertraline 50 mg daily; codeine allergy.

plan_component_evidence.risk_safety: The plan includes safety planning or suicide risk assessment.
plan_component_evidence.cbt_cognitive_restructuring: The plan includes CBT-style cognitive restructuring (thought challenging).
plan_component_evidence.behavioural_activation: The plan includes behavioural activation (increasing meaningful activities).
plan_component_evidence.exposure: The plan includes exposure-based work for anxiety or avoidance.

c_008.plan: Therapy: CBT for ADHD focusing on organizational skills. Medication: Continue/monitor sertraline 50 mg daily; stimulant (e.g., methylphenidate) or non-stimulant (atomoxetine). Skills: time management, task breakdown, and environmental modifications. Follow-up: symptom tracking and medication response. Case anchors: Problem: attention-deficit/hyperactivity disorder. Constraints/Meds: sertraline 50 mg daily; codeine allergy.

c_009.plan: Therapy: ERP (Exposure and Response Prevention). Medication: Continue/monitor sertraline 50 mg daily; SSRI at higher doses (e.g., fluoxetine 40-60mg). Skills: response prevention strategies and uncertainty tolerance. Follow-up: OCD severity (Y-BOCS) and ritual time. Case anchors: Problem: obsessive-compulsive disorder. Constraints/Meds: sertraline 50 mg daily; penicillin allergy.

c_010.plan: Therapy: DBT first-line (skills group plus individual sessions) or MBT where DBT is unavailable. Medication: symptom-targeted adjuncts only; do not rely on medication as primary treatment. Risk management: maintain collaborative safety plan and weekly review of self-harm urges and triggers.

plan_component_evidence.exposure: The plan includes exposure-based work for anxiety or avoidance.

c_011.plan: Therapy: motivational interviewing and relapse prevention. Medication: Continue/monitor acamprosate 666 mg three times daily; naltrexone or acamprosate; disulfiram if appropriate. Skills: trigger identification, coping strategies, and support group attendance. Follow-up: abstinence tracking, liver function, and craving intensity. Case anchors: Problem: alcohol use disorder (early recovery). Constraints/Meds: acamprosate 666 mg three times daily; codeine allergy.

c_012.plan: Therapy: pain management program with CBT for chronic pain. Medication: Continue/monitor duloxetine 60 mg daily; antidepressant with pain benefits (e.g., duloxetine, amitriptyline). Skills: pacing, activity scheduling, and cognitive coping for pain. Follow-up: pain levels, functional status, and mood. Case anchors: Problem: chronic pain with depression. Constraints/Meds: duloxetine 60 mg daily; codeine allergy.

c_013.plan: Therapy: family-based therapy (FBT) or CBT-E for eating disorders. Medication: limited role; address comorbid depression/anxiety. Skills: meal planning, body image work, and cognitive flexibility. Follow-up: weight restoration, vital signs, and electrolytes. Case anchors: Problem: anorexia nervosa (in recovery). Constraints/Meds: codeine allergy.

c_014.plan: Therapy: CBT with behavioural activation for depression. Medication: SSRI first-line (for example sertraline) with routine side-effect monitoring. Monitoring: PHQ-9 tracking at each review and functional recovery goals. Safety: assess suicidal ideation at every contact and maintain a collaborative safety plan if risk escalates.

c_015.plan: Therapy: psychoeducation and CBT-focused relapse prevention for bipolar depression. Medication: mood stabiliser first-line (lamotrigine preferred; alternatives include lithium or quetiapine). Avoid SSRI monotherapy; consider antidepressant only as adjunct with mood-stabiliser cover. Monitoring: assess mood switching, sleep pattern, and suicidality at each review.

c_016.plan: Therapy: CBT adapted for older adults; reminiscence therapy. Medication: Continue/monitor sertraline 50 mg daily; SSRI with attention to drug interactions and side effects. Skills: behavioral activation, social engagement, and meaningful activity. Follow-up: depression severity, cognitive status, and medical comorbidities. Case anchors: Problem: late-life depression. Constraints/Meds: sertraline 50 mg daily; codeine allergy.

c_017.plan: Therapy: CBTp (CBT for psychosis) and family intervention. Medication: Continue/monitor psychosis (stable, on medication); antipsychotic medication with metabolic monitoring. Skills: reality testing, early warning sign recognition, and social skills. Follow-up: positive/negative symptoms, medication side effects. Case anchors: Problem: psychosis (stable, on medication). Constraints/Meds: risperidone 2 mg nightly; codeine allergy.

c_018.plan: Therapy: stress management and supportive counseling. Medication: Continue/monitor sertraline 50 mg daily; antidepressant if depression develops. Skills: respite planning, boundary setting, and self-care scheduling. Follow-up: burnout symptoms, depression screening, and respite utilization. Case anchors: Problem: caregiver burnout. Constraints/Meds: sertraline 50 mg daily; codeine allergy.

c_019.plan: Therapy: CBT for health anxiety and somatic symptoms. Medication: Continue/monitor sertraline 100 mg daily; low-dose antidepressant for symptom management. Skills: attention shifting, activity pacing, and medical reassurance reduction. Follow-up: healthcare utilization and symptom distress. Case anchors: Problem: somatization disorder with health anxiety. Constraints/Meds: sertraline 100 mg daily; codeine allergy.

c_020.plan: Therapy: CBTp and family intervention; vocational rehabilitation. Medication: Continue/monitor risperidone 2 mg nightly; antipsychotic with metabolic monitoring. Skills: early warning signs, medication adherence, and social engagement. Follow-up: symptom severity, side effects, and functional goals. Case anchors: Problem: schizophrenia (prodromal phase). Constraints/Meds: risperidone 2 mg nightly; codeine allergy.

c_021.plan: Therapy: phase-oriented trauma therapy with grounding focus. Medication: Continue/monitor sertraline 100 mg daily; address comorbid PTSD/depression. Skills: grounding techniques, safety signals, and containment strategies. Follow-up: dissociation frequency and trauma processing progress. Case anchors: Problem: dissociative episodes (comorbid with PTSD). Constraints/Meds: sertraline 100 mg daily; codeine allergy.

c_022.plan: Therapy: CBT adapted for older adults; relaxation training. Medication: Continue/monitor sertraline 100 mg daily; SSRI with careful titration; avoid benzodiazepines. Skills: worry management, relaxation, and cognitive restructuring. Follow-up: anxiety severity, fall risk, and cognitive function. Case anchors: Problem: late-life anxiety with mild cognitive concerns. Constraints/Meds: sertraline 100 mg daily; codeine allergy.

c_023.plan: Therapy: CBT with mirror exposure and response prevention. Medication: Continue/monitor fluoxetine 20 mg daily; SSRI at higher doses (similar to OCD). Skills: reducing checking/camouflaging, cognitive restructuring. Follow-up: BDD severity and insight level. Case anchors: Problem: body dysmorphic disorder. Constraints/Meds: fluoxetine 20 mg daily; codeine allergy.

c_024.plan: Therapy: graded exposure for avoidance triggers. Follow-up: monitor symptoms, medication effects if relevant, and review/practise homework. Case anchors: Problem: burnout syndrome with depressive features. Constraints/Meds: sertraline 50 mg daily; codeine allergy.

plan_component_evidence.exposure: The plan includes exposure-based work for anxiety or avoidance.
